content_blocks.text: The Procurement Lawyers’ Association holds a number of events throughout the year including seminars and talks, in addition to the AGM. The PLA Committee has suggested the idea of holding a dinner, open for attendance to all members, which could become an annual event depending on uptake. With this in mind, we should be grateful if you would indicate your interest in attending a networking dinner, most likely to be a location in London for the first event, for which we would hope to book a relevant and interesting after dinner speaker. Depending on the numbers involved we would then consider venue, timing and format. Please respond by email to rachel.bacon@bevanbrittan.com. If there are any additional observations which you would like the PLA to take into account in organising a dinner, for example any restrictions on attendance or logistical considerations, please email your comments to Rachel Bacon using the email address above. We should be grateful for your response by Friday 14 September 2018.
